sourceNotes.rawContent: Enhance your elegance with this premium pink and white floral enamel kada. Featuring a high-quality gold finish, this anti-tarnish and water-resistant piece is built for long-lasting brilliance. Its intricate floral detailing and modern silhouette make it an essential statement piece for any fashion-forward collection.
